related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

authenticated_source_records.record_level_pattern: The same missing objective and session linkage appears in three distinct committed regression records; the records do not establish that they came from three distinct sessions.

compiler_capability_evidence.resource_measurement_scope: The report's resource and duration values are per-build measurements. They do not establish Compiler agent session consumption or campaign duration.
compiler_capability_evidence.native_adoption_scope: These cache regression reports demonstrate compiler behavior; they do not establish implementation ownership, host-code displacement, migration readiness, or a native-versus-host adoption ratio.

environmental_capability_accountability.implementation: The Environment main commit contains a schema- and identity-family-specific adapter for these Compiler regression reports.
environmental_capability_accountability.integration: Registering the exact committed source pointers in the campaign evidence ledger makes the reports available to the on-demand environmental-capability projection.
environmental_capability_accountability.agent_objective_attribution: not-established; none of the three Compiler source records contains campaign, session, or work-intent fields, and no exact authenticated source-context record is available here.

actionable_opportunity.title: Connect verified Compiler regression evidence to its authenticated development objective
actionable_opportunity.candidate_boundary: Compiler regression evidence capture and Environment exact-source-context correlation
actionable_opportunity.readiness: The projection can expose bounded cache-stage evidence. Agent-objective attribution remains unavailable until an authenticated Compiler context record references the exact committed evidence blob.
actionable_opportunity.safe_next_step: Have the Compiler evidence producer attach or reference authenticated campaign, session, and work-intent context through the established Environment provenance mechanism; retain unknown attribution when that context cannot be established.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Committed Compiler regression evidence cannot yet be joined to its originating development objective
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Compiler regression evidence capture and Environment provenance projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Three distinct committed Compiler cache regression records omit campaign, session, and work-intent identifiers. The Environment adapter can derive bounded compiler behavior from exact source pointers, but attribution requires a verified supporting context record; report multiplicity does not prove cross-session recurrence.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Connect each Compiler regression artifact to its authenticated objective through an exact verified source-context record, then use the Environment projection to inspect the derived compiler evidence and its provenance together.
